scenarios.title: Payments library 2.0 (.NET)
scenarios.description: A C# library's real Roslyn extraction, classified by ApiCompat's rules: an interface gains a member without a default implementation, an inheritable class gains an abstract member, Card becomes sealed, an enum value and a constant change, and a parameter is renamed; a type, members and a default-implemented interface member are added.

scenarios.title: Rate limiter 2.0 (Rust)
scenarios.description: A crate's real rustdoc extraction, classified by the Cargo SemVer reference: an exhaustive enum gains a variant, an all-public struct gains a field, a trait gains a method without a default, a method gains a parameter and loses const, a private Rc field drops Send and Sync, and a constant's value changes.

scenarios.title: Ledger 2.0 (Go)
scenarios.description: A module's real go/types extraction, classified by apidiff's rules: an interface gains a method, so a type stops implementing it; a struct gains a slice field and stops being comparable; a method moves to the pointer method set; a function gains a variadic parameter; and constants change value. A numeric type grows, compatibly.

scenarios.title: Job queue 2.0 (TypeScript)
scenarios.description: A TypeScript package's real checker extraction, classified by assignability: a required parameter and a required interface member are added, a parameter narrows and a method is removed; optional parameters, members and union members are added, and a return type narrows.

scenarios.title: HTTP client 2.0
scenarios.description: A major release removes token handling and an enum, widens several signatures, renames fetchJson to getJson, and adds streaming and retry types.

scenarios.title: Parser options
scenarios.description: Parsing and printing gain options, errors become diagnostics, the visitor helper is removed, and Element stays as it was.
